note: STEP 9 OF design/PLAN-zero-alert-days-remainder-2026-09-24.md, two-signal identity, SHADOW ONLY. The first signal is the commodity's include/exclude rules over the product NAME. This file declares the SECOND: where each store's own capture records the store's category for a row, and how that store's words translate into the ONE department vocabulary aisle-lib.ps1 already uses (Family Fare's shelf departments). The EXPECTED departments per commodity are NOT declared here: they are aisle-lib.ps1's reviewed tables ($AISLE_CAT_DEPT by estate category from categories.json, $AISLE_COMMODITY_DEPT per commodity), read through Test-AisleAllowed, so there is one expected set in the estate and not two. commodities.json is not read for categories and is not edited by this step. Read by grocery/audit-store-category-share.ps1 and grocery/audit-crown-identity-shadow.ps1.
ad_files_note: Weekly-ad and deals files carry no category at any store today; they are counted by the coverage audit (rows filtered to the store) so the denominator is every captured row, and the shadow reaches an ad crown only through a same-named regular row or, at Family Fare, the flyer-link evidence.
rule: A store value that maps to no department (listed under neutral, or simply absent) gives NO SIGNAL for that row: counted, never agree, never a failure. A multi-valued field (split) gives the set of its mapped values, and the row AGREES when any of them is allowed for the commodity. Never add a mapping without reading that store's own products under the value: a guessed mapping turns the second signal back into a copy of the first.

Family Fare.evidence_note: Weekly Ad lines carry no shelf path on the board. The flyer-link lane resolves each line to a Freshop product and records its canonical_url, whose first /shop/ segment is the department (aisle-lib Get-AisleDept). A crown whose own link has no shelf path is looked up there by ad line, then by product id, then by the regular file's row of the same name.
